questions.label: Ranked Wins
questions.prompt: Since 2020, which school has more wins over AP-ranked opponents, and how many?
questions.reveal: Kentucky 9, Louisville 5 (through 2025). Latest: Kentucky: 2023 vs. No. 22 Florida 33–14, 2023 vs. No. 9 Louisville 38–31, 2024 vs. No. 6 Ole Miss 20–17; Louisville: 2023 vs. No. 20 Duke 23–0, 2024 vs. No. 11 Clemson 33–21, 2025 vs. No. 2 Miami 24–21.

info.title: What counts as a ranked win?
info.text: A win over a team in the AP Top 25 the week of the game (bowls use the last regular-season poll), regular season and postseason, through 2025.

questions.label: Historic Day
questions.prompt: 2007: No. 9 Louisville vs. Kentucky. Harry Douglas caught 13 passes. How many receiving yards did he finish with?
questions.reveal: 223 receiving yards and 1 TD, the most by anyone in this rivalry since 2004 (box scores). Louisville still lost, 40–34.

questions.label: Twist
questions.prompt: The 2023 Louisville–Kentucky game went to Kentucky, 38–31, over No. 9 Louisville. Which team gained more total yards, and by how much?
